purpose: Draft an isolated matter-coupling gate. This document is a proposed protocol, not an implementation, result, frozen registry, or scientific verdict.
scientific_question: Does adding a real matter field Phi with a symmetry-breaking potential and controlled coupling to a frozen psi sector produce finite, stable, convergent, and reproducible coupled dynamics that differ measurably from uncoupled and negative-control systems?
scope_exclusions: No Omega, quantum, Liouville, CFT, consciousness, or BCJ claim
candidate_action: S_CP10 = S_psi + integral[ 1/2 |grad Phi|^2 + lambda_Phi/4 (Phi^2-v_Phi^2)^2 - eta Phi^2 psi ] dx

must_include_before_execution: explicit F_psi and delta F_psi/delta psi

proposed_dynamics.assumption: For P0.1 only, psi is a conserved Model-B field with constant M_psi and Phi is a nonconserved Model-A field with constant M_Phi.
proposed_dynamics.mu_Phi: -Delta Phi + lambda_Phi Phi(Phi^2-v_Phi^2) - 2 eta Phi psi
proposed_dynamics.derivation_note: Both chemical potentials are variational derivatives of the candidate action. The chosen metric, not the action alone, defines the time evolution.

numerical_design.integrator: proposed Fourier pseudo-spectral block semi-implicit IMEX; constant-coefficient linear terms implicit, nonlinear terms explicit with 2/3 de-aliasing
integrator_constraints: psi Fourier zero mode preserved exactly
Phi has no claimed conserved mass
no discrete-energy monotonicity claim unless separately derived for the selected IMEX scheme

negative_controls: frozen-psi feedback ablation: evolve Phi against the matched eta=0 psi trajectory while psi itself remains uncoupled
phase-permuted psi: preserve psi Fourier amplitudes and zero mode while deterministically permuting nonzero-mode phases
sign-reversed action arm +eta Phi^2 psi for eta in {0.05,0.1}; interpret only as a structural control, not as the target model

initial_conditions.psi: exact frozen-baseline generator; same realization is used for every matched condition
initial_conditions.Phi: band-limited Gaussian random field with zero mean, standard deviation 0.05, modes |k|<=4, independently seeded

conditions.anti_tuning: The listed values and seed split are fixed before the first coupled evaluation. Calibration may establish that code meets hard validity checks but may not choose parameters, thresholds, or the primary endpoint.

observables.primary: For matched seed s, E_s = sqrt( mean_{t in [1,10],x} (psi_eta(s,t,x)-psi_0(s,t,x))^2 ) / max(sqrt(mean_{t in [1,10],x} psi_0(s,t,x)^2), 1e-12). Report mean E_s and a two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap CI over the 16 held-out seeds using 10,000 deterministic resamples (seed 20260825).
secondary: discrete energy-law residual reported as a diagnostic
condition-level sensitivity to eta, lambda_Phi, v_Phi
solver/step rejection diagnostics and physical-versus-numerical-instability classification

thresholds.name: nonfinite_count
thresholds.rule: equals 0 for every saved state and accepted step
thresholds.justification: NaN/Inf makes all downstream numerical comparison undefined.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: solver, implementation, or parameter instability; no scientific inference.

thresholds.name: psi_zero_mode_error
thresholds.justification: Periodic constant-mobility Model-B evolution has an exactly preserved Fourier zero mode in the proposed spectral representation.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: conservation or implementation defect; invalid run.

thresholds.name: bounded_fields_and_energy
thresholds.rule: all reported field magnitudes and each energy component finite; any |Phi| or |psi| > 1e6 is a hard stop
thresholds.justification: The numerical ceiling is a catastrophic-overflow guard, not a physical bound.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: numerical blow-up unless independently resolved by refinement.

thresholds.name: energy_law_residual
thresholds.rule: report R_E = |Delta F + integral_dt(M_Phi mu_Phi^2 + M_psi |grad mu_psi|^2)| / max(1,|Delta F|,integral_dt(...)); median R_E <= 1e-3 and 95th percentile <= 1e-2 on the two finest dt values
thresholds.justification: The continuous mixed gradient-flow identity is exact; finite residual allows IMEX truncation while requiring refinement-resolved behavior.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: discretization/sign/derivative mismatch; it does not alone prove physical instability.

thresholds.name: spatial_convergence
thresholds.rule: relative primary-observable discrepancy |E_64-E_128|/max(E_128,1e-12) <= 0.05 and |E_32-E_64|/max(E_64,1e-12) <= 0.15 for the primary target
thresholds.justification: Successive-grid agreement is required before interpreting a coupling effect; tolerances are deliberately looser at coarse resolution and fixed before runs.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: unresolved spatial discretization or aliasing; no CP10 effect claim.

thresholds.name: temporal_convergence
thresholds.rule: at N=128, relative discrepancy of E between dt/2 and dt/4 <= 0.02 and the dt-to-dt/2 discrepancy is no smaller than the dt/2-to-dt/4 discrepancy beyond a 1e-12 noise floor
thresholds.justification: Requires practical refinement and guards against a falsely stable time step without assuming a formal order.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: time discretization unresolved or noise-floor dominated; rerun protocol is invalid until diagnosed.

thresholds.name: spectral_tail
thresholds.rule: mean energy in retained modes with |k|>2N/3 is <= 1e-4 of total retained spectral energy at each output time
thresholds.justification: The 2/3 rule leaves this band as an aliasing-resolution monitor.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: under-resolution or aliasing; distinguish from physical high-frequency structure via refinement.

thresholds.name: seed_reproducibility
thresholds.rule: rerun three predeclared held-out seeds {1001,1008,1016}; every scalar artifact agrees to relative 1e-10 or absolute 1e-12 in the declared deterministic environment
thresholds.justification: Exact deterministic reruns are expected for fixed CPU/GPU, precision, libraries, and seeds; cross-hardware comparisons are report-only.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: environment or RNG provenance gap; effects cannot be called reproducible.

thresholds.name: primary_effect
thresholds.rule: lower endpoint of the 95% bootstrap CI for mean E_s exceeds max(0.02, 3*max(spatial_error,temporal_error)) and the corresponding frozen-psi and phase-permuted controls do not both meet that same criterion
thresholds.justification: 0.02 is a predeclared dimensionless practical effect floor; the three-times-numerical-error term prevents resolution error being presented as an effect.
thresholds.failure_interpretation: no earned measurable coupled-dynamics difference under P0.1; this is not evidence that all matter coupling is absent.

pass_requires_all: all hard-validity thresholds for every required primary-target run
complete artifacts and deterministic finalizer verification
fail_or_inconclusive_if_any: threshold/parameter/seed change after coupled evaluation begins
pass_fail_logic.immutability_rule: No threshold, seed, condition, primary endpoint, or finalizer field may change after execution begins. Any change creates a new protocol identifier and new calibration phase.

per_condition: field snapshots/checkpoint hashes at declared outputs
artifacts.finalizer_rule: The finalizer may aggregate and validate declared artifacts only; it must not alter outcomes, parameters, or promotion logic.

claims.earned_if_pass: Within the frozen P0.1 periodic two-dimensional mixed Model-B(psi)/Model-A(Phi) protocol and its tested parameter grid, the specified matter coupling produced finite, stable, convergent, deterministic, control-separated dynamics with a predeclared measurable difference from eta=0.
remain_unearned: Omega, quantum, Liouville, CFT, BCJ, consciousness, or fundamental-theory claims

prerequisites: CP10-P0.1 pass with immutable source and finalizer receipts
a separately specified CP11 scientific question, action, controls, data/gate definition, and acceptance thresholds
if geometry is proposed, a separate geometry prerequisite and factorial arm with its own discretization and gauge/boundary audits
cp11.reason: No recovered authoritative CP11 definition exists; CP10 does not validate geometry or any CP11-specific claim.
